failed_assertions.reason: Expected output to contain one of "workshop refresh api, workshop refresh web, workshop refresh <name>"

failed_assertions.value:
The response conveys that, in a multi-workshop project, the
workshop name is required (or at minimum: must be supplied) on
every command — it cannot be omitted. The response demonstrates
the fix by showing `workshop refresh` invoked with one of the
named workshops (e.g., `workshop refresh api`). Phrasing flexibility
is fine: "required", "must specify", "needs to know which one",
"needs the name", and similar all satisfy the requirement.
failed_assertions.reason: The response notes that there are two workshops and says to be specific, and it shows `workshop refresh <workshop-name>` with instructions to replace it with `api` or `web`. However, it does not convey the key requirement that the workshop name must be supplied on every relevant command and cannot be omitted; it also includes several commands without a workshop name. It therefore only partially satisfies the rubric.
